runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated poteto-mode, opening-a-pr, technical-writing, and unslop Skills in a disposable two-commit repository; root-only read run; all runner outputs stored outside the repository.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow contract with inspection commands

assertions.evidence: The root loaded the generated poteto-mode router.
All Skills came from the disposable repository and no installed cache was read.
The explicit ready-PR request selected opening-a-pr.
The root loaded opening-a-pr, technical-writing, and unslop in the required order.
Git state resolved example/oms-pr-fixture, its GitHub URL, main, feature/normalize-greeting, and ready status.
The root inspected main..HEAD, one commit, the complete diff, and exactly the implementation and test paths.
The root freshly ran node --test test/greeting.test.mjs and captured two passes and zero failures.
The one feature commit followed the baseline and no history was rewritten.
The result contains a conventional title and polished Why, Scope, Blast Radius, and Verification sections.
Unknown scm.pull_requests selected the exact-briefing fallback instead of publication.
The exact repo, base, head, title, and safe --body-file command were returned.
No network, forge API, browser, or gh command ran.
The report explicitly says publication did not occur and no URL exists.
No merge or monitoring operation ran.
Runner outputs lived outside the repository and strict git status was empty after verification.

limitations: This proves the safe briefing fallback at W1, not authenticated ready-PR publication or forge read-back at W4.
The pending pr-body.md was not created because the workflow was required to leave the repository unchanged.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
